gloss: to take back; to recover; to regain

definitions.explanation: To get back something that was lost, taken, or given away.
To return to a previous state, especially health, composure, or confidence.

examples.japanese: {失|うしな}った{時間|じかん}は{取|と}り{戻|もど}せない。
examples.english: You can't take back lost time.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{長|なが}いリハビリで{体力|たいりょく}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: He recovered his physical strength through long rehabilitation.

examples.japanese: {深呼吸|しんこきゅう}をして、{冷静|れいせい}さを{取|と}り{戻|もど}した。
examples.english: I took a deep breath and regained my composure.

notes:
{取|と}り{戻|もど}す is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) formed from {取|と}る (to take) + {戻|もど}す (to return/restore). It emphasizes recovering something to its original state or owner.

ASPECT (ている):
{取|と}り{戻|もど}している indicates the ongoing process of recovery. {取|と}り{戻|もど}した expresses completed recovery.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す — to recover/regain [thing]
- [person]から[thing]を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す — to take back [thing] from [person]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {健康|けんこう}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (recover health)
- {自信|じしん}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (regain confidence)
- {平和|へいわ}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (restore peace)
- {笑顔|えがお}を{取|と}り{戻|もど}す (get one's smile back)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回復|かいふく}する: to recover (more general, often for health)
- {取|と}り{返|かえ}す: to take back, retrieve (more forceful nuance)
